title: Implement Cursor human-message extraction
description:
Implement extraction: IDE type-1 (user) bubbles with text from the text field (not richText), timestamps from createdAt (epoch milliseconds), ordering from fullConversationHeadersOnly; verify on a real Mac that harness-injected context (context additions, terminal selections, system reminders) never appears in a type-1 bubble's text — if it does, classify and exclude those bubbles. Agent transcripts: user-role lines only, per the schema pinned in the capture task, with injected context excluded; store.db enriches metadata only (names, timestamps), never duplicates as a message source.

Done when: golden extraction tests pass for IDE fixtures (both index shapes) and agent-transcript fixtures; injected content never counts.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Extraction: IDE type-1 (user) bubbles from the text field (not richText) with createdAt epoch-ms timestamps, ordered by fullConversationHeadersOnly; assistant bubbles, empty texts, checkpoint and messageRequestContext blobs ignored; queries stream by key prefix (never SELECT *). Agent transcripts: user-role message lines only with injected-context exclusion (system-reminder/context wrappers); store.db enriches metadata only and is never a message source. Golden tests pass for both index shapes and agent fixtures. Outcome: green; the injected-context-never-appears-in-type-1-bubbles check and the agent line schema are pinned by KDATAP-e9aa3c on a real Mac.
